story.eyebrow: A BREW AND A BITE FOR EVERY TIME OF DAY
story.heading: Italian Soul Meets Vadodara's Vibrant Restro Culture
story.paragraph1: Named after the Italian word for 'Sky', Cielo was envisioned as an unhurried sanctuary where artisanal coffee, slow-crafted stone-baked pizzas, and heartwarming conversations converge under warm ambient arches.
story.paragraph2: From sunlit morning flat whites and fresh sourdough bruschetta to twilight candlelit dinners with rich truffle spaghetti and bubbly mocktails, Cielo transitions effortlessly from your daytime workspace into an electric evening restro.
story.quote: Conversations, laughter, and bits of truly good food.

qualityIngredients.heading: Crafted With Handpicked Ingredients
qualityIngredients.paragraph: Every sauce is simmered from scratch with San Marzano style tomatoes, every herb is picked at peak aroma, and our artisanal dough is cold-fermented for 48 hours to create that unforgettable airy blistered crust.

events.heading: Intimate Celebrations Under the Cielo Sky
events.subheading: Whether it is an intimate birthday celebration, a memorable kitty party, an acoustic live evening, or a productive team gathering, we curate customized menus and unforgettable aesthetics for your special milestones.
features: Dedicated hospitality team & floral table styling
Indoor lounge & illuminated arch seating for up to 45 guests
Audiovisual setup for acoustic evenings & corporate meets
